warnings: Units are inferred as inches from the imperial decimal dimensions and NPT/thread callouts; no explicit unit declaration is visible. No named drawing standard or scale is visible.
Revision is interpreted from CHG #1, dated 4-16-76. Original date is 4-9-76. The separate bottom-right text 400 B is not treated as a revision or scale.
G markings on the two thickness faces likely indicate grinding, but no finish legend or numerical surface roughness is supplied.

General tolerance applies to one- and two-decimal dimensions only. No general tolerance for the .344 three-decimal through-hole diameter is printed. Zero tolerance fields for unspecified or derived values must not be interpreted as zero manufacturing variation.
All hole coordinates are nominal values obtained from the printed dimension chains and common centerlines. Derived-coordinate tolerance stacks have not been independently assigned.

Do not impose equal .38 edge margins: the printed dimensions produce .37 right and lower corner-hole margins. The corner array is therefore nominally offset .005 from the envelope center in each direction.

The .50-13 callout specifies thread nominal size and .8 thread depth, not a .50 pilot drill. Thread series/class, pilot size, and pilot drill depth require manufacturing clarification; 1/2-13 UNC is a likely interpretation but is not explicitly stated.

H005 and H006 split the single two-place .25 NPT callout because the bores enter different, perpendicular faces. Their instance_positions are entry locations projected into the global Top-view x/y frame; both axes are z=.75.

For the NPT holes, .44 is the specified drill diameter and 2.1 is drilled depth. The .25 is nominal pipe size, not actual thread diameter. NPT tapping depth/engagement is not given and must be resolved before manufacture.

Bottom-entry port coordinates use the global Top-view frame, not a mirrored bottom-view coordinate frame. Drill depth 1.1 is interpreted from the bottom face, with the .123 counterbore included within that depth.
The transverse passages intersect the .50 face ports with nominal .22 lateral axis offsets; these are intentional intersecting passages, not concentric bore groups.

Blind drill-point geometry is depicted but drill-point angles and depth-to-point versus full-diameter conventions are not explicitly specified. Do not add an assumed numerical tip angle to the extracted dimensions.
No GD&T frames, datum designations, reference dimensions, numerical chamfers, or fillet radii are visible. No additional views are present.
